name: hector-footwear-wholesale
comment:overrides: sharp/postcss are pinned above the versions Next 16.3.6 pulls in, to clear high-severity advisories (libvips CVEs in sharp <0.35, postcss sourcemap path traversal). Next declares sharp as an optionalDependency at ^0.34.5, so this intentionally forces a newer minor than it asks for — verified working: build, image optimization and the E2E suite all pass. Revisit when Next bumps its own range. Deliberately NOT overriding brace-expansion: v5 changed to named exports and breaks minimatch/ESLint, and the advisory is a dev-only tooling DoS that never reaches the deployed app.
